screen.too_small: Enlarge the tile or open it for the map

app.name: Rain radar
app.summary: The rain radar of RainViewer over an OpenStreetMap map, centred on coordinates you choose.
app.lat_hint: In degrees, such as 52.2297 (south is negative).
app.lon_hint: In degrees, such as 21.0122 (west is negative).
app.zoom_hint: 2 shows about a continent, 7 about a region. RainViewer's radar tiles stop at 7.
app.look_hint: Auto follows the screen: the map is dimmed when the screen is dark (OpenStreetMap has no dark map).
app.map_hint: Off shows the radar alone, on the card's own colour.
app.snow_hint: Draws snow in its own colours.
app.fullscreen_hint: A tap on the map opens it over the whole screen. Off does nothing on a tap.
app.dim_hint: How much the dark look darkens the map, in percent. 0 leaves it light.
app.marker_color_hint: The colour of the dot or icon.
app.center_hint: On keeps the coordinates exactly in the middle; the map is then a window around them and can be small. Auto does so only when the window stays large and otherwise fills the tile. Off always fills the tile, and the dot shows the place.
app.marker_hint: The standard dot, or an icon from the list.
app.smooth_hint: Blurs the radar data a little.
